## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (run `make css` first if you changed style classes in templates, and commit `web/static/app.css`)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, such as `fix(panel): ...`
- [ ] Code, comments, messages and docs are in English; user-facing text goes through `web/locales/en.json`
- [ ] Tests cover the change
